mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_contact_way ( config_id, state, remark, scene, type, skip_verify, user_list, qr_code, welcome_text, crm_event_id, raw_request, raw_response, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{configId}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{scene}, #{type}, CASE WHEN #{skipVerify,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{userListJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), #{qrCode}, #{welcomeText}, #{crmEventId}, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{rawRequestJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{rawResponseJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
